bio_md:
# 元宁宗懿璘质班 · 主要事迹

孛儿只斤懿璘质班（1326—1332），明宗次子。至顺三年（1332）文宗崩，临终遗命传位明宗之子；燕铁木儿先立明宗次子懿璘质班，即位于大都。

宁宗即位仅四十余日而崩，未及改元，仍用至顺年号。其崩后，燕铁木儿复欲立文宗之子，因文宗遗言而罢，终迎明宗长子妥欢帖睦尔于广西，是为[[yuan-hui-zong|惠宗]]。

宁宗以幼冲即位、旋崩，为天历政变余波中的一瞬。

Borjigin Irinchibal (1326-1332), second son of Mingzong. When Wenzong died in 1332, his deathbed decree returned the throne to Mingzong's line; El Temur raised Irinchibal at Dadu.

Ningzong reigned barely forty days and died without changing the era, the Zhishun years still running. After his death El Temur would have raised a son of Wenzong but was bound by the decree; in the end Toghon Temur, Mingzong's eldest son, was brought from Guangxi to the throne as

.

A child sovereign raised and taken in a flash - a moment in the wake of the Tianli storm.
